name: Paul Bradley
bio: Paul Bradley was born on July 26, 1901 in New York City, New York, USA as Anthony Poliseno. He is known for his work on Jeep Herders (1945), Music Man (1948) and Stewardess School (1986). He died on June 18, 1999 in Tarzana, Los Angeles, California, USA.
place: New York City, New York, USA
